Title: CLI Parameter Attribute
Summary: Attribute for marking method parameters as CLI-bindable. Supports required, default values, descriptions, and multiple types.
Content:
# CLI Parameter Attribute

This document describes the `[CliParam]` attribute used to mark method parameters as CLI-bindable parameters.

**Location:** `Attributes/CliParamAttribute.cs`

```csharp
namespace Cyrena.CLI.Attributes;

[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Parameter, Inherited = false, AllowMultiple = false)]
public sealed class CliParamAttribute : Attribute
{
    public CliParamAttribute(string name);
    
    public string Name { get; }
    public bool Required { get; set; }
    public object? DefaultValue { get; set; }
    public string? Description { get; set; }
}
```

## Purpose

The `CliParamAttribute` marks a method parameter as bindable from command-line arguments. Only parameters marked with this attribute will be populated from CLI arguments.

## Properties

### Name
The parameter name used in command-line arguments (without the `--` prefix).

```csharp
[CliParam("config")]  // Invoked as: --config=value
public string Config { get; set; }
```

### Required
Indicates whether the parameter must be provided. Defaults to `false`.

```csharp
[CliParam("name", Required = true)]  // Must be provided
public string Name { get; set; }
```

### DefaultValue
Optional default value if the parameter is not provided.

```csharp
[CliParam("count", DefaultValue = 10)]
public int Count { get; set; }  // Defaults to 10 if not specified
```

### Description
Optional description shown in help text.

```csharp
[CliParam("timeout", Description = "Operation timeout in seconds")]
public int Timeout { get; set; }
```

## Usage

### Basic Parameter

```csharp
[CliSurface]
public class ConfigCommands
{
    [CliCommand("set")]
    public void SetConfig(
        [CliParam("key")] string key,
        [CliParam("value")] string value)
    {
        Console.WriteLine($"Set {key}={value}");
    }
}
```

**Invocation:**
```bash
./app set --key=timeout --value=30
```

### Required Parameter

```csharp
[CliCommand("create")]
public void CreateUser(
    [CliParam("username", Required = true, Description = "User's username")] 
    string username)
{
    // username must be provided
}
```

**Error if missing:**
```bash
./app create
# Error: Required parameter '--username' is missing for command 'create'.
```

### Parameter with Default Value

```csharp
[CliCommand("process")]
public void Process(
    [CliParam("batch-size", DefaultValue = 100, Description = "Items per batch")]
    int batchSize)
{
    // Defaults to 100 if not specified
    Console.WriteLine($"Processing in batches of {batchSize}");
}
```

**Invocation:**
```bash
./app process              # batchSize = 100
./app process --batch-size=50  # batchSize = 50
```

### Boolean Flag

```csharp
[CliCommand("run")]
public void Run(
    [CliParam("verbose", DefaultValue = false, Description = "Enable verbose output")]
    bool verbose)
{
    if (verbose) Console.WriteLine("Verbose mode enabled");
}
```

**Invocation:**
```bash
./app run                  # verbose = False
./app run --verbose=true   # verbose = True
```

### Nullable Parameter

```csharp
[CliCommand("update")]
public void Update(
    [CliParam("name")] string name,
    [CliParam("age", DefaultValue = null)] int? age)
{
    if (age.HasValue)
        Console.WriteLine($"Updating age to {age.Value}");
}
```

### Array Parameter

```csharp
[CliCommand("process-files")]
public void ProcessFiles(
    [CliParam("files", Required = true, Description = "Comma-separated file paths")]
    string[] files)
{
    foreach (var file in files)
        Console.WriteLine($"Processing {file}");
}
```

**Invocation:**
```bash
./app process-files --files=file1.txt,file2.txt,file3.txt
```

### List Parameter

```csharp
[CliCommand("add-tags")]
public void AddTags(
    [CliParam("tags", Description = "Comma-separated tags")]
    List<string> tags)
{
    foreach (var tag in tags)
        Console.WriteLine($"Tag: {tag}");
}
```

**Invocation:**
```bash
./app add-tags --tags=urgent,important,review
```

### Enum Parameter

```csharp
public enum LogLevel { Debug, Info, Warning, Error }

[CliCommand("set-log")]
public void SetLogLevel(
    [CliParam("level", DefaultValue = LogLevel.Info, Description = "Logging level")]
    LogLevel level)
{
    Console.WriteLine($"Log level set to {level}");
}
```

**Invocation:**
```bash
./app set-log --level=Debug
./app set-log              # Defaults to Info
```

## Supported Types

| Type | Example | Notes |
|------|---------|-------|
| `string` | `--name=value` | Basic text |
| `int` | `--count=10` | Integer numbers |
| `long` | `--size=1000000` | Large integers |
| `double` | `--rate=3.14` | Decimal numbers |
| `bool` | `--verbose=true` | Boolean flags |
| `DateTime` | `--date=2024-01-01` | ISO format |
| `Guid` | `--id=...` | GUID format |
| `Enum` | `--level=Debug` | Case-insensitive |
| `T?` | `--age=30` | Nullable types |
| `T[]` | `--files=a,b,c` | Comma-separated |
| `List<T>` | `--tags=x,y,z` | Comma-separated |

## Parameter Binding Rules

1. **Only marked parameters are bound** - Unmarked parameters receive default values or cause compilation errors if required.

2. **Case-insensitive matching** - `--Name`, `--name`, `--NAME` all match `[CliParam("name")]`.

3. **Format:** `--parameterName=value` or `--parameterName value`

4. **Quoted values:** `--message="Hello World"` preserves spaces.

5. **Array/List values:** Comma-separated without spaces: `--items=a,b,c`

## Complete Example

```csharp
[CliSurface]
public class DataCommands
{
    [CliCommand("import", Description = "Imports data from a file")]
    public CliExecutionResult Import(
        [CliParam("file", Required = true, Description = "Path to input file")]
        string file,
        
        [CliParam("format", DefaultValue = "csv", Description = "File format (csv, json, xml)")]
        string format,
        
        [CliParam("batch-size", DefaultValue = 1000, Description = "Records per batch")]
        int batchSize,
        
        [CliParam("skip-header", DefaultValue = false, Description = "Skip first row")]
        bool skipHeader,
        
        [CliParam("columns", Description = "Columns to import")]
        string[]? columns)
    {
        try
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"Importing {file} (format: {format})");
            Console.WriteLine($"Batch size: {batchSize}, Skip header: {skipHeader}");
            
            if (columns != null)
                Console.WriteLine($"Columns: {string.Join(", ", columns)}");
            
            // Import logic...
            
            return CliExecutionResult.CommandExecuted("Import completed!");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            return CliExecutionResult.Stop(1, $"Import failed: {ex.Message}");
        }
    }
}
```

**Help Output:**
```bash
./app help import
```
```
Usage: import [options]

Description:
  Imports data from a file

Options:
  --file<string> (required)
      Path to input file
  --format<string> [default: csv]
      File format (csv, json, xml)
  --batch-size<int> [default: 1000]
      Records per batch
  --skip-header<bool> [default: False]
      Skip first row
  --columns<string[]>
      Columns to import
```

**Invocation:**
```bash
./app import --file=data.csv --format=csv --batch-size=500 --skip-header=true --columns=id,name,email
```
